bullets.content: [general] Reference-free estimate under-read true field error ~1.5x on both tasks (bc0: 7% est vs 10.7% true; bc7: 12.5% vs 18.8%). Multiply by 1.5 before computing (g/2)^2/c; rank solves by that, never by lowest error or raw estimate.

[general] Change one factor per solve; write 'FACTOR: name old→new' before each mesh call and diff the refinement list. Use all 4 solves so compare() attributes gains. Choose submission by gain/DOFs (3x gain at 2.3x DOFs scored only 0.80); submit cheaper mesh when error is under target.

[general] Use all 4 solves: assigned variant, opposite-direction test, best combination, then a hotspot fix where local h >1.3x request. Prefer structural changes (move a box, drop edges, change body size) over size tweaks. Test removing the least-proven refinement.

[general] Never compare a solve with itself or repeat a compare pair (g4 compare(1,2) twice). Write the ids before calling, coarse first; after each new solve compare it with the candidate it replaces.

[general] After every solve (including solve 1) with mesh changed >500 nodes, view(kind=error), list top-5 hotspots with local h vs requested size. A miss >1.3x (f2 0.003 gave 0.00458) means the size never applied: fix before solving again.
[general] Don't pick a solve by strain energy alone; it converges much faster than stress field error. Use compare() and estimate x1.5 with e\u00b2\u00b7DOFs.

[general] Before submit, call compare(a,b) on two DIFFERENT solves; read stress_diff_energy_norm_rel and top regions, combine with energy and DOF change. Never submit without it once you have 2+ solves.

[general] Pick submission by estimated e\u00b2\u00b7N (below target), field ~ energy calibration (~0.1% energy ~ 1% field), e~N^-0.43. It correctly chose 17.3k DOFs over 19.5k (est 630 vs 654). Within 3% take fewer DOFs.
[general] When starting from a peer recipe, list every difference from it in the plan. Silent changes (box size + dropped edge) make the experiment uninterpretable.
[general] To test a region already refined by a face/edge size, change THAT size (e.g. f2 0.0025->0.002). A box coarser than the existing local size only refines bulk: +11% DOFs for +0.2% energy.

[general] With coarse global h (>0.009) and local sizes 0.003-0.004, use radius >=0.01. h 0.0095 r0.006-0.007 gave min quality 0.078; h 0.009 r0.01 gave 0.113; h 0.013 with 0.0045 box r0.008 gave 0.244; h 0.012 r0.008 gave 0.131. Keep h>=0.012, r>=0.008.
[general] A refinement smaller than ~0.3x global h under-delivers (f2 0.003 at h 0.03 gave 0.0046; flanks 0.0035 gave 0.0047-0.0052). Request ~0.75x the desired local h and pair with a covering box.
[general] Setup verified: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f2, pressure 4e6 Pa on f23, 2.1e6 Pa on f16. Copy verbatim; diffuse error changes are mesh.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Older a8 variant (h 0.03, flanks 0.003, edges 39/8 0.0035) gave 19.1% at 17.3k DOFs, e\u00b2N ~630, no gain over a14 635. Superseded: stop tuning flank size; change placement or body size.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Radius variant of a3 (7073 nodes, 0.033576 J, field 17.4%): zone radii 0.008->0.0055, quadrant/rim 0.005->0.0035. Pays if nodes drop >=5% with energy loss <=0.05x node drop %. If min_quality <0.15 raise zone radii to 0.0065; solve 2: quadrant/rim r0.007, zones r0.0055.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Run mesh() first and check nodes vs expected; need min_quality >=0.15. Check rim hotspot local h after solving.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Solve plan: S1 assigned variant; S2 flanks 0.0028 to measure size slope; S3 better of S1/S2 with edges 39/8 back at 0.0025. compare(S1,S2), submit by lowest e\u00b2\u00b7N.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After every solve view(kind=error, iso and -x) BEFORE next mesh(). Record local h of f19/f16 rim hotspots (|x|~0.019, z~0.030) vs requested 0.003; in g5 s2 rim stayed 0.00482 inside a 0.003 box, unseen.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Older variant call (superseded by the explorer call below if testing placement): h=0.012, box 0.0048 r0.008, f2/edges 39/8/40 at 0.0025 r0.005; expect ~19k DOFs, field ~17.5-18%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction band x ±0.0174, z 0.0255 held 14.2% (h 0.0052-0.0054) plus 12.1% at |y| 0.0129 without band boxes. a1's 0.003 boxes cut cells to 2.5-2.8% at h 0.0040. Always box this band.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] +x junction cell (0.0174,0.0129,0.0255) held 4.47% with 45 elements: wall at |y| 0.013-0.017 lay outside |y|<=0.013 saddle and |y|<=0.01 rim boxes. Keep box ymax >=0.016 (a8 flanks). Self idea: saddle y \u00b10.015, z 0.016-0.030, offset by cutting body box.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Thin-wall boxes deliver ~1.3x requested size (0.0035→0.0045-0.0048; 0.003→0.0040). Request 0.003 for ~0.004 in junction band; check hotspot local h after solving.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a1 (field 17.2%, best): h 0.012, body 0.0048, f2 0.0022 r0.004, junction boxes x ±0.012..±0.023, |y|<=0.012, z 0.022-0.0345 at 0.003 r0.004, no edges. Adapt the band, don't copy.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a14 (best base 0.244, e\u00b2N 635): h 0.012, body 0.0054 r0.008, f2 0.0025 r0.005, edge 40 0.0025 r0.004, flank boxes 0.003 r0.004. Body 0.0058 reads -11% at lower-wall cell near f20 (z~0.005), confirmed again; keep z 0-0.021 at <=0.0054 (a3 lower zone 0.0046).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a3 (field 17.4%, best accuracy): lower box 0.0046 + upper 0.0058, quadrant boxes [\u00b10.007..0.022,|y| 0.005-0.018,z 0.019-0.033] 0.0032 r0.005, rim boxes [\u00b10.015..0.024,|y|<=0.01,z 0.025-0.035] 0.003, f2 + edge 40 0.0025. Junction mid cells stay 3.1-3.6%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle hotspots near f20/f10/f12/f13 (|x|~0.014, |y|~0.009, z~0.022) hold 5-8% in every run at h 0.0039-0.005. a7 point refinements 0.0028 barely changed nodes (+94). Use a box (±3-4 mm), not points.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle boxes (0.003) + upper boxes (z 0.032-0.042, 0.0035) on body 0.0055: 19.3k DOFs, 0.03306 J, equals rim-only recipe at 16.9k. Don't use without rim coverage (z 0.028-0.032 gap). Upper boxes are least proven: test removing.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Rim boxes [\u00b10.015..0.024,|y|<=0.01,z 0.026-0.034] 0.003 r0.005 added: +1.0% energy for +8.3% DOFs, field 17.9%. Pays; keep rim coverage in every recipe. Saddle+upper+body 0.0055 gave 17.9% at 20.9k, similar to a1 17.2%: DOFs are the lever.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring z~0.056 is saturated: box 0.0032 [-0.017,-0.017,0.051,0.017,0.017,0.0575] over f2 0.0025 + edge 40 gave +0.2% energy for +11% DOFs. Never stack a clamp box coarser than f2 size; ring stays f2 + edge 40.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Explorer: drop edges 39/8 and flank boxes; saddle boxes plus upper-ring boxes on body 0.0055, est 18-20k DOFs. Tests whether the rim needs its own target.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] At h 0.012 keep f2 0.0025 + edge 40 0.0025 r0.004 (touching ~0.0040; edge 40 +0.41% energy for +4.4% DOFs). At h 0.03 f2 0.003 gave 0.00458, clamp 14.3%: never use f2 0.003 under coarse h.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never drop edge 40 silently. Without it clamp-ring cells (±0.0058, ±0.0129, z 0.0561) held 15.7% of error at h 0.0045 and f2 touching was 0.00458 vs 0.003; with edge 40 0.003 ~11-12%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 are dead or weak: at 0.0035 inside 0.0035 flank boxes nodes changed by 15; at 0.0025 f16 touching still 0.0057-0.0059. Edge inside a box must be <=0.6x box size or dropped. Drop them; put ~1k DOFs into rim box.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] h 0.03 left shafts f15/f17 at 0.0086-0.0096; f16 shaft cell read +29% vs consensus. With any h >0.012 add shaft boxes [0.023,-0.01,0.02,0.034,0.01,0.042] + mirror at 0.006 r0.004.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Error map at 17-19% field: clamp ring z 0.056 14-17%, junction mid cells 12%, rim hotspots off f16/f19 ~10%, corner wall cells (\u00b10.0058,\u00b10.0129,0.0255) 10%. DOF savings must keep h <=0.0042 there.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Rim hotspots (|x|~0.0197,|y|~0.007,z 0.028-0.030, f16/f19) sit at h 0.0047-0.0052 with 21-22% error even inside flank boxes. Try box [0.016,-0.01,0.025,0.024,0.01,0.034] at 0.0026 r0.004, flank box lowered to z 0.019-0.025.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring cells hold 14% error energy at h 0.0043-0.0045 even with f2 0.003 + edge 40. Try f2 0.0025 with edge 40 0.002 r0.004, compensating with body box 0.0065.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Error flat across body: 64 cells hold 43% at mean h 0.0045; 20.9k DOFs on plateau at 17.9%. Try cheaper variant: body box 0.0065 with stronger band (~14k DOFs) to gain on cost term.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] P3 (0.0122,-0.0111,0.0067) is +12.7% off; hidden worst near f20 (-0.006,-0.013,0.036). Add 0.0035 box on lower wall |y| 0.009-0.015, z 0-0.012 only if DOF budget allows and field <~12%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Field error binds (18.5% vs 10.3% points); chasing points buys nothing until field <~12%. Hidden point RMS earlier 13-16%: misses in clamp-top region, mid wall under -y; worst hidden near f21 (0.0058,-0.0043,0.056).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Hidden check-point RMS (11%) exceeds disclosed (9.5%); worst 19.9% near f21 at z 0.056, the clamp top: point error also points at the clamp ring, not flanks.
